title: The merge tool posts a review record after each review round
why: Follow-up of step review-rounds-rework. Lesson 1 of 4 from lane priority-vs-merge-order (relayed 04:04 CST Nov 14, lane's own read, unchecked by triage): post the tool-printed review record right after each passing round. Triage sorts it here, not on fail-round-needs-record-before-push (coordinator's pick, 04:05): this step's title is "the merge tool posts a review record after each review round", which covers the PASS case; the FAIL-round step is a push guard for one case. Titles read, fit not proven; the coordinator may overrule. Sighting 04:17 CST Nov 14 (lane test-helper-has-a-home, tool outputs it quoted, relayed by the coordinator 04:16; unchecked by triage): once a PR head moves, `merge --review-record --head <old head>` exits 1 ("the pull request head is <new>, not the reviewed <old> ... No override lifts this refusal"), and `--fix-check <old>` exits 2 ("the reviewed head must be the Head of the newest earlier review log on this pull request ... (no earlier record exists)"). A round that passed at head A but was not recorded before the next push can get neither a record nor a fix check; the only route is a fresh round at the live head. Cost: a fresh round. Second case of lesson 1 (the first: the #3378 and #3250 lanes). Filed here, where triage sorted lesson 1 of the closed step lane-four-lessons-unfiled; the coordinator asked for it on that step, which is closed. Cases 04:21 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:21, relayed; unchecked by triage): the old-head record refusal has now hit four lanes: #328, #3233 (earlier), #3395 (04:12) and #3389 (local-autonomy-equals-cloud, head 93df5839b684, draft). #3389 opened its PR after round 3 and never posted a record at the reviewed head 6f367b532; six lint-fix commits later the tool refuses both the record at 6f367b532 and `--fix-check`. Route the coordinator gave: a fresh round 1 at the live head. The coordinator asks to raise this to a build step ahead of the queue: it is already doing (lane in the lane field), so triage leaves the order to the coordinator and the owner's ruling own-ready-by-priority; the case count is the evidence for the priority. Case that is new here: a lane that opens a PR after its reviews cannot get a record for the reviewed head at all. Route that worked 04:58 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:57, relayed; mailaudit #324): rounds 1 (haiku) and 2 (sonnet) were recorded at 7daa55fc, then main was merged in, then a fresh sonnet fix check was accepted with `--head e00b874f --fix-check 7daa55fc`. So a record posted at the reviewed head before the next push lets a later base merge carry a fix check; the refusals above hit only lanes that never posted the record. One more case where main moved under a recorded head, and the tool handled it. Data point 05:14 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 05:15, runner 10's `--reviewed` log at 05:13; not read by triage; the cost not timed): the records step on draft #3377 (merge-lint-skip-green-rollup) pushed a records-page commit, head 732293c9b3 to 8c4dfb4219ed, and so made the review record stale; #3377 now waits on a fix check at 8c4dfb4219ed, asked of lane merge-tool-audit-fixes. For #3349 the records step did not make it stale (docs-only). So for a guard or check PR the records step adds a new head, a lane lint cycle and a fix check (runner 10's wording). A data point for the records-page choice (owner item 830), not a ruling. SIGHTING 08:31 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 08:31, relayed; the coordinator read REST comments on #3401 at 08:27; the refusal text verbatim is the coordinator's; triage read none): lane silent-undo-trailer-rewrite reviewed #3401 through round 1 FAIL, round 2 PASS, fix check PASS, but posted no record row at any head, so the tool refused every row at the live head c1da982d76fb: "the --fix-check reviewed head must be the Head of the newest earlier review log; none exists". REST comments on #3401 show only lane-lint rows. Cost so far: three rounds of reviewer work lost to the record, and one fresh round 1 owed at the live head (coordinator's pick: a fresh reviewer; the tool decides what is next). Third case beside #3377 and #324's counter-case. Debt candidate (coordinator): the lane brief template says "post the record row after each round, at the head it read". Guard that would have stopped it: this step (the tool or lane lint refuses a hand-in with a review and no record row at the reviewed head). SIGHTING 09:05 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 09:03, the lane's account; unread by triage): #3403's round-1 FAIL record was missed before the fix push, so the tool refused the fix check. Fourth case beside #3377, #324's counter-case and #3401. EVIDENCE 09:12 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 09:06, from the lane; unchecked by triage): on #3401 the fresh round 1 found a real hole (code conditionals passing the negation excuse) that three earlier unrecorded rounds had missed. Evidence for the step: a round whose record is missing is lost work, and the review found a defect the earlier ones did not; not a reason to skip rounds. The owner item the coordinator names on this step: none is on the page (triage has posted none). RECORDS ON #3404 09:43 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 09:40, read by the coordinator): 6879572556 (head 44dcee1525e4, round 1 sonnet PASS) and 6879824600 (head 95962808606f, round 1 sonnet PASS + fix check on the merge of main, net value not owed). Round 1 ran sonnet there. The 97 min chain on #3272, #3403 and #3404 is also the cost the step's missed records add. MORE REFUSALS 11:10 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 11:06, relayed; triage read none of them): three more lane refusals read as "restarts the review": #3180, #2839 and #2970 (with the earlier ones, seven fold PRs: #3158, #3180, #2733, #2970, #3063, #2839, #3226; the coordinator replaced their lanes at 10:50 CST). Each lane now builds one replacement PR on the coordinator's re-brief (its own picks, undoable).
